findings.title: Sensitive kernel commands remain main-window allowlisted
evidence: tool-window capability uses coreside-tool-scoped allowlist without those permissions
kernel_cmds.rs handlers check require_profile() but not an extra operator role
findings.detail: Raw invoke from the trusted main React webview can reach these commands. Tool windows cannot. Generated surfaces do not receive Tauri IPC. Not a new Critical remote exploit; residual risk is XSS-in-main → local policy/package operations.
findings.suggestedChange: Optional: require_main_window + explicit settings/operator gate for policy override / package export / mark-last-known-good if product wants defense-in-depth beyond capability allowlists.
findings.remainingRisk: Main-webview XSS could call sensitive kernel commands; mitigate via CSP (script-src 'self') and no raw HTML rendering.
